"Temptation" is a single-player electro-mechanical pinball machine released by Chicago Coin Machine Manufacturing Company in November 1948.

- Manufacturer: Chicago Coin Machine Mfg. Co.
- Years made: 1948
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Lights
- Players: 1
